{{Quote|I am Prime Adjunct Ti-Ori Tamun. We apologize for the alarming method of your arrival to Oluna Biqua, good folk. This has certainly not been the vacation you were looking for.|Tri-Ori Tamun, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="No Place Like Home">{{LivingForce|No Place Like Home}}</ref>}}
[[Prime Adjunct]] '''Ti-Ori Tamun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Tamun worked in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Oluna Biqua]] and after the dispersal of [[Trinex-M]] gas in the city, many residents of Oluna Biqua were given pseudo abilities to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents, traveled to Oluna Biqua for a vacation and Tamun met with them and escorted them to [[Nestin Thokor]], Oluna Biqua's [[comptroller]]. Thokor hired the agents to find a cure for the gas and after the Heroes of Cularin had obtained an antidote from a group of [[Metatheran Cartel]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], Tamun escorted the agents back to Thokor.
